name: Prusa Connect
description: Prusa Connect is a self-hosted, local-first server for managing 3D printers on your own network without relying on cloud infrastructure. It provides a web dashboard for live printer monitoring, G-code file uploads, print control, user accounts, and permissions, along with a REST API, server-sent events, MQTT sinks, and an extension marketplace.

notes.text: Get the current setup code by running 'journalctl _SYSTEMD_INVOCATION_ID=$(systemctl show -p InvocationID --value prusa-connect) | grep setup_code' inside the container.
Prusa Connect is in public beta (0.x pre-releases). Back up your container or /opt/prusa-connect_data before updating.
Prusa printers require firmware 6.4.0 or newer and a prusa_printer_settings.ini file generated on the Add a printer page.
